# d4.cr

d4.cr is a Crystal library for [D4](https://github.com/38/d4-format) files. It reads local and remote files, including files with multiple tracks, and writes single-track files. 

## Install

Add to `shard.yml`, then run `shards install`. Crystal 1.21 or later is required.

```yaml
dependencies:
  d4:
    github: bio-cr/d4.cr
```

## Read values and intervals

```crystal
require "d4"

D4.open("depth.d4") do |file|
  p file.chromosomes.map(&.name)
  p file.value("chr1", 100)
  p file.values("chr1", 100, 110)

  file.each_interval("chr1", 100, 110) do |interval|
    puts "#{interval.left}\t#{interval.right}\t#{interval.value}"
  end
end
```

Coordinates are zero-based. `start` is included and `stop` is excluded. Raw values are `Int32`; chromosome sizes and interval positions are `Int64`.

## Write one track

```crystal
chromosomes = [D4::Chromosome.new("chr1", 1_000_i64)]

D4.create("depth.d4", chromosomes: chromosomes,
  dictionary: D4::Dictionary.new(0_i32, 8_i32)) do |writer|
  writer.write_values("chr1", 0, [1_i32, 2_i32, 3_i32])
  writer.write_interval("chr1", 100, 200, 5_i32)
end
```

The dictionary puts values in `0...8` in the primary table; other `Int32` values go to the secondary table. Unwritten positions default to `0`. Write chromosomes in declaration order and positions in increasing, non-overlapping order. Existing files are preserved unless `WriteOptions.new(overwrite: true)` is set.

## Summarize a region

```crystal
region = D4::Region.new("chr1", 100_i64, 200_i64)

D4.open("depth.d4") do |file|
  p file.sum(region)
  p file.summary(region).mean
  p file.histogram(region, value_range: 0_i32...100_i32).counts
  p file.coverage(region, thresholds: [1_i32, 10_i32]).counts
  p file.scaled.mean("chr1", 100, 200)
end
```

`scaled` divides stored values by the track's metadata denominator.

## Read multiple tracks

```crystal
D4.open("multi.d4") do |file|
  p file.track_names
  p file.track("sample_a").value("chr1", 100)

  matrix = file.matrix(["sample_a", "sample_b"])
  matrix.each_row(D4::Region.new("chr1", 100_i64, 105_i64)) do |row|
    puts "#{row.position}: #{row.values}"
  end
end
```

For file-level reads of a multi-track file, open it with `track: "sample_a"`. Matrix tracks must have the same chromosomes and lengths.

## Stream large regions

```crystal
D4.open("large.d4") do |file|
  nonzero = 0_i64
  buffer = Slice(Int32).new(65_536)
  file.default_track.scan_values("chr1", buffer) do |_start, values, _count|
    values.each { |value| nonzero += 1 if value != 0 }
  end
  puts nonzero
end
```

`values` materializes an array and defaults to a 64 MiB limit. `scan_values` reuses the buffer; process its slice before the next callback. `Writer#write_values` also accepts a lazy `Enumerable(Int32)`.

## Compression and indexes

```crystal
options = D4::WriteOptions.new(
  compression: D4::Compression.deflate,
  indexes: [D4::IndexKind::SecondaryFrames, D4::IndexKind::Sum]
)

D4.create("indexed.d4",
  chromosomes: [D4::Chromosome.new("chr1", 1_000_i64)],
  options: options) do |writer|
  writer.write_interval("chr1", 100, 200, 5_i32)
end

# For an existing local file without indexes:
D4.build_indexes("plain.d4")
```

`build_indexes` makes a temporary copy in the same directory, so allow disk space for another copy of the file. `D4::WriteControl` supports progress callbacks and cancellation during writing and index building.

## Read over HTTP

```crystal
require "d4/http"

source = D4::HTTPSource.new("https://example.org/depth.d4")
D4.open(source, sync_close: true) do |file|
  p file.sum("chr1", 0, 1000)
end
```

The server must support HTTP byte-range requests. Pass a `HTTPSource`, not a URL string, to `D4.open`.

## Origin and license

Hao Hou, Brent Pedersen, and Aaron Quinlan introduced D4 in their [paper](https://doi.org/10.1038/s43588-021-00085-0). The [original Rust project](https://github.com/38/d4-format) provides d4tools. d4.cr is a separate Crystal implementation by kojix2; Brent Pedersen also wrote [d4-nim](https://github.com/brentp/d4-nim).

types.doc:
D4 format library for Crystal

D4 is a format designed to store quantitative data associated with genomic intervals.
It provides efficient compression and fast random access for depth data and similar
genomic quantitative information.

## Usage

### Reading D4 files

```
D4.open("data.d4") do |file|
  puts file.chromosomes.map(&.name)
  puts file.mean("chr1", 1000, 2000)
  file.each_interval("chr1", 1000, 2000) do |interval|
    puts "#{interval.left}-#{interval.right}: #{interval.value}"
  end
end
```

### Writing D4 files

```
D4.create("output.d4", chromosomes: [D4::Chromosome.new("chr1", 1000_i64)],
  dictionary: D4::Dictionary.new(0_i32, 8_i32)) do |writer|
  writer.write_values("chr1", 0, [1_i32, 2_i32, 3_i32])
end
```

@track.check_open
if @position >= @region.stop
  return stop
end
left = @position
right = left + (Math.min(@bin_size, @region.stop - left))
sum = 0_i64
min = Int32::MAX
max = Int32::MIN
(right - left).times do
  value = @values.next
  if value.is_a?(Iterator::Stop)
    return stop
  end
  sum = sum + value
  if value < min
    min = value
  end
  if value > max
    max = value
  end
end
@position = right
BinSummary.new(left, right, Summary.new(right - left, sum, min, max))

payload = FrameStream.read(source, offset, DIRECTORY_FRAME_SIZE, limit)
entries = Array(Entry).new
names = Set(String).new
cursor = 0
while cursor < payload.size && (payload[cursor] != 0_u8)
  if (cursor + 18) > payload.size
    raise(FormatError.new("truncated directory entry"))
  end
  if payload[cursor] == 1_u8
  else
    raise(FormatError.new("invalid directory entry marker"))
  end
  kind = payload[cursor + 1]
  if kind <= 2_u8
  else
    raise(FormatError.new("invalid directory entry kind"))
  end
  relative = Endian.u64_le(payload, cursor + 2)
  size = Endian.u64_le(payload, cursor + 10)
  name_start = cursor + 18
  name_end = name_start
  while name_end < payload.size && (payload[name_end] != 0_u8)
    name_end = name_end + 1
  end
  if name_end >= payload.size
    raise(FormatError.new("unterminated directory entry name"))
  end
  name = String.new(payload[name_start, name_end - name_start])
  if name.empty?
    raise(FormatError.new("empty directory entry name"))
  end
  if relative > Int64::MAX || size > Int64::MAX
    raise(FormatError.new("directory entry offset exceeds Int64"))
  end
  if names.add?(name)
  else
    raise(FormatError.new("duplicate directory entry #{name.inspect}"))
  end
  if relative > (source.size - offset) || size > ((source.size - offset) - relative.to_i64)
    raise(FormatError.new("directory entry exceeds source"))
  end
  if (kind != 2_u8) && size < FRAME_HEADER_SIZE
    raise(FormatError.new("invalid stream frame size"))
  end
  entries << (Entry.new(kind, offset + relative.to_i64, size.to_i64, name))
  cursor = name_end + 1
end

@mutex.synchronize do
  if @closed
    raise(ClosedError.new("HTTP source is closed"))
  end
  if (offset < 0 || offset >= @size) || buffer.empty?
    return 0
  end
  copied = 0
  limit = (Math.min(buffer.size.to_i64, @size - offset)).to_i
  while copied < limit
    position = offset + copied
    start = (position // @block_size) * @block_size
    if cached = @blocks[start]?
      @order.delete(start)
      @order << start
    else
      if @order.size >= @cache_blocks
        block_start = @order.shift
        @reuse = (@blocks.delete(block_start)) || (raise(Error.new("HTTP cache is inconsistent")))
      end
      cached = fetch(start, (Math.min(@block_size.to_i64, @size - start)).to_i)
      @blocks[start] = cached
      @order << start
      @reuse = Bytes.empty
    end
    from = (position - start).to_i
    count = Math.min(limit - copied, cached.size - from)
    buffer[copied, count].copy_from(cached[from, count])
    copied = copied + count
  end
  copied
end

def.body:
if kinds.empty?
  raise(ArgumentError.new("no index kinds requested"))
end
control.update(WriteProgress.new(WriteStage::BuildingIndexes))
D4.open(path, track: track) do |file|
  control.check!
  selected = file.default_track
  root = Format::Directory.open_root(file.source, file.options.max_metadata_bytes)
  directory = root
  (selected.name.split('/')).each do |component|
    if component.empty?
      next
    end
    entry = directory.entry(component, 1_u8)
    directory = Format::Directory.open(file.source, entry.offset, file.options.max_metadata_bytes)
  end
  old_index = directory.entry?(".index")
  old_entries = if old_index
    if old_index.directory?
    else
      raise(CorruptIndexError.new(".index is not a directory"))
    end
    (Format::Directory.open(file.source, old_index.offset, file.options.max_metadata_bytes)).entries
  else
    [] of Format::Entry
  end
  ::File.open(path, "r+b") do |output|
    output.seek(0, IO::Seek::End)
    index_offset = output.pos.to_i64
    root_items = directory.entries.reject do |entry| entry.name == ".index" end.map do |entry|
      DirectoryEncoder::Item.new(entry.kind, entry.name, entry.offset, entry.size)
    end
    root_items << (DirectoryEncoder::Item.new(1_u8, ".index", index_offset, Format::DIRECTORY_FRAME_SIZE.to_i64))
    if (DirectoryEncoder.build(directory.offset, root_items)).size == Format::DIRECTORY_FRAME_SIZE
    else
      raise(UnsupportedFeatureError.new("track directory has no room for .index"))
    end

    output.write(Bytes.new(Format::DIRECTORY_FRAME_SIZE))
    index_items = old_entries.reject do |entry|
      ((entry.name == "secondary_frame_index") && (kinds.includes?(IndexKind::SecondaryFrames))) ||
      ((entry.name == "sum_index") && (kinds.includes?(IndexKind::Sum)))
    end.map do |entry| DirectoryEncoder::Item.new(entry.kind, entry.name, entry.offset, entry.size) end

    if kinds.includes?(IndexKind::SecondaryFrames)
      offset = output.pos.to_i64
      write_sfi(file, directory, output, control)
      index_items << (DirectoryEncoder::Item.new(2_u8, "secondary_frame_index", offset, output.pos.to_i64 - offset))
    end
    if kinds.includes?(IndexKind::Sum)
      offset = output.pos.to_i64
      write_sum(selected, output, control)
      index_items << (DirectoryEncoder::Item.new(2_u8, "sum_index", offset, output.pos.to_i64 - offset))
    end
    index_directory = DirectoryEncoder.build(index_offset, index_items)
    if index_directory.size == Format::DIRECTORY_FRAME_SIZE
    else
      raise(UnsupportedFeatureError.new("index directory is too large"))
    end
    index_end = output.pos.to_i64
    output.seek(index_offset, IO::Seek::Set)
    output.write(Format.bytes(index_directory))
    root_items[-1] = DirectoryEncoder::Item.new(1_u8, ".index", index_offset, index_end - index_offset)
    control.check!
    output.seek(directory.offset, IO::Seek::Set)
    output.write(Format.bytes(DirectoryEncoder.build(directory.offset, root_items)))
    output.flush
  end
end

def.name: run
def.body:
if count == 0
  return
end
active = Math.min(Math.min(count, workers), System.cpu_count)
jobs = Channel(Int32).new(Math.min(count, active * 2))
group = WaitGroup.new(active)
error_mutex = Mutex.new
error = nil.as(Exception | ::Nil)
active.times do
  context.spawn do
    begin
      scratch = Slice(Int32).new(65536)
      while index = jobs.receive?
        if error_mutex.synchronize do !error.nil? end
          next
        end
        begin
          block.call(index, scratch)
        rescue ex
          error_mutex.synchronize do error || (error = ex) end
        end
      end
    ensure
      group.done
    end
  end
end
count.times do |index| jobs.send(index) end
jobs.close
group.wait
if exception = error
  raise(exception)
end

  raise(ClosedError.new("source is closed"))
end

low = 0_i64
high = @count

  middle = low + ((high - low) // 2)

  key_pos = (Format::Endian.u32_le(scratch, shift + 4)).to_i64

  return

if (Format::Endian.u32_le(scratch, shift)) == chromosome_id
else
  return
end

if start < @next_position[chromosome]
  raise(Error.new("writes must be monotonic and non-overlapping"))
end
index = @chromosome_indices[chromosome]
if index < @current_chromosome_index
  raise(Error.new("writes must follow chromosome declaration order"))
end
if values.empty?
  return 0_i64

advance_primary(metadata, index, start)
dictionary = metadata.dictionary
width = dictionary.bit_width
cursor = start
if width == 0
  values.each do |value|
    if (cursor % 65536) == 0
      @control.check!
    end
    if dictionary.encode(value)
    else
      append_secondary(chromosome, cursor, cursor + 1, value)
    end
    cursor = cursor + 1
  end
elsif (dictionary.type.simple_range? && width <= 8) && (@bit_count == 0)
  cursor = append_dense_range(chromosome, cursor, values, dictionary, width)
else
  fallback_code = (1_u32 << width) - 1_u32
  values.each do |value|
    if (cursor % 65536) == 0
      @control.check!
    end
    code = dictionary.encode(value)
    append_primary_code(code || fallback_code, width)
    if code
    else
      append_secondary(chromosome, cursor, cursor + 1, value)
    end
    cursor = cursor + 1
  end
end
@encoded_position = cursor
@current_chromosome_index = index
@next_position[chromosome] = cursor
